info.title: Hiboutik Universal API
info.description: Hiboutik is a cloud point-of-sale platform for retail and hospitality businesses. Use this app to manage catalog data, customers, inventory, sales, kitchen operations, reporting, and store settings through the Hiboutik REST API.
